''13, 31''.}} mu{{ls}}tard {{ls}}eede, vvhich a man tooke and ca{{ls}}t into his garden, and it grevv: and became a great tree, and the foules of the aire re{{ls}}ted in the boughes thereof. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=20|align=float}}† And againe he {{ls}}aid, * {{outside R|''Mt. 13, 33.''}} Like to vvhat {{ls}}hal I e{{ls}}teeme the kingdom of God? {{verse|chapter=13|verse=21|align=float}}† It is like to leauen, vvhich a vvoman tooke and hid in three mea{{ls}}ures of meale, til the vvhole vvas leauened. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=22|align=float}}† And he vvent by cities and tovvnes teaching, and making his iourney vnto Hieru{{ls}}alem.
